text: The premise of asymmetric information is architecturally invalidated in the AI-to-AI economy because every inference, parameter update, decision trace and model weight is by design cryptographically attested, version controlled and auditable in real time across federated networks.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The AI-to-AI Economy and the Collapse of Anthropocentric Economic Theory (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5886442

isBasedOn.name: The AI-to-AI Economy and the Collapse of Anthropocentric Economic Theory

abstract: In the AI2AI economy, this foundational premise is architecturally invalidated. Every inference, every parameter update, every decision trace, and every model weight in an autonomous agent is, by design, cryptographically attested, version-controlled, and auditable in real time

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: assumes agents operate on attested, federated or otherwise verifiable substrates
